North Carolina mating designs

Source: R/breeding.R
nc_designs.Rd

Simulated data of the three North Carolina designs, each in two sets with two replicates per set.

Usage

nc_designs

Format

A list of three data frames:

nc1

Design I: Set, Rep, Male (three per set), Female (four per male, labelled within the male) and Yield_t_ha; 48 rows.

nc2

Design II: Set, Rep, Male and Female (four of each per set) and Yield_t_ha; 64 rows.

nc3

Design III: Set, Rep, Male (six F2 plants per set), Tester (P1, P2) and Yield_t_ha; 48 rows.

Examples

nc_design(nc_designs$nc1, "Yield_t_ha", "Male", "Female", block = "Rep", set = "Set", design = 1)
#> 
#> North Carolina design I (females nested within males)
#> Response: Yield_t_ha   sets = 2, blocks per set = 2, males per set = 3, females per male = 4

#> Females(males) 18 15.325 0.85140   9.703 1.096e-06 ***
